Class AlgoReplayMarketData

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoReplayMarketData
All Implemented Interfaces:
AlgoHistoricalValuationService.ClosingPrices, AlgoMeanReversionDecisionService.MarketData
public class AlgoReplayMarketData extends Object implements AlgoMeanReversionDecisionService.MarketData, AlgoHistoricalValuationService.ClosingPrices
The only window a historical replay has on the market, and the place where "no look-ahead" is enforced rather than merely intended.

Every observation of the run is read once, ascending, up to the run's end date; a request for a day returns the prefix of that list which ends at the requested day. A quote of a later day is therefore not filtered out somewhere downstream - it is not reachable at all, whatever a decision module asks for. The live intraday quote of an instrument is never read here, because this class talks to the historical repository only.

The same instance answers both the indicator window of a decision and the closing price a valuation needs, so a day cannot be decided against one set of prices and valued against another. Warm-up is what makes the two differ in length: an indicator may read the observations before the opening date, while the valuation only ever looks at the last one.

  • Field Details

    • OBSERVATION_WINDOW

      public static final int OBSERVATION_WINDOW
      How many observations a decision may see. The live evaluation bounds its own reads to the same number, so an indicator that needs a longer history is unavailable in a replay for exactly the same reason it is unavailable live.

  • Constructor Details

    • AlgoReplayMarketData

      public AlgoReplayMarketData(AlgoTradingRepository data, LocalDate openingDate, LocalDate horizonEnd)
      Parameters:
      data - the historical repository, which is the only price source of a replay
      openingDate - the immutable opening date of the simulation environment, which is the first day that has to be valued and therefore the oldest day the window must still reach
      horizonEnd - the last day of the run; nothing after it is ever loaded
